statistical_review.simpson: Dataset signs differ; keep datasets separate, do not hide tradeoff with pooled mean.
statistical_review.ecological: No individual benefit or population-wide superiority inferred from domain averages.
statistical_review.berkson: Historical development sample reused; external generalization not established.
statistical_review.collider: Date strata descriptive only; no causal adjustment claims.
statistical_review.base_rate: 512-user denominator and gains/losses preserved; no diagnostic-prevalence claim.
statistical_review.regression_to_mean: No new subset or next experiment selected from extreme subgroup gains.
statistical_review.survivorship: All planned arms and all512 users completed in both domains.
statistical_review.look_elsewhere: Many uncorrected paired intervals; no confirmatory significance claim.
statistical_review.forking_paths: Frozen protocol followed; same reused dev set remains exploratory.
statistical_review.causation: Architecture substitution differs beyond time; real-vs-order is one-seed controlled pipeline contrast.
statistical_review.reverse_causality: History-only chronology checked in preflight; no target dates used.
